title: Bodily exercise vs eternal life
english: Gymnastics sharpens limbs and senses — but [[bodily training is of little profit >> Bible:1 Timothy 4:8]] for eternal life. Exercise the soul on God’s riddle.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Pose a riddle to the house of Israel
english: [[Son of man, propound a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel >> Bible:Ezekiel 17:2]]. Train the inner eye on the allegory. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
